name: release-2026-2-1-f
description: What the 2026-09-26 in-client smoke still owed: F1 the guide's side chapter tabs on a wide window, F2 the Filler's preview toggle on a volume box (button, tooltips, cubes, off-screen), F3 a working robot's exhaust on Minimal particles. Generated by generators/gen_release_2026_2_1.py.

steps.label: window 1600x900 (GUI coordinates below assume it with guiScale 3)
F1: a window wide enough for side tabs (640 GUI units at guiScale 3; under 590 the guide uses its Chapters overlay instead)
F1: turn to the contents page

steps.name: f1-contents-wide
steps.look: F1: the contents page (3/24) on a wide window: chapter tabs stand out from the book's left edge (no 'Chapters' tab peeking over the top of the right page), and the three sort buttons down the left page's top-left corner are whole, not covered by a tab

steps.label: F1: back to the scenario window
F2: go to the drag spot with the Marker Connector
F2: sneak (removes the box an earlier run left)
F2: a Volume Box on the floor's top face makes a 1x1x1 box above it
F2: grab the box's corner with the Marker Connector
F2: release it two blocks over, up and back (a 3x3x3 box)
F2: place a Filler on the floor against the box's north face (its back is toward the box)
F2: the Filler's saved preview flag starts false (expect 0b)

steps.name: f2-box-with-filler
steps.look: F2: a 3x3x3 volume box (its outline, drawn striped now that a machine locks it) in front with the Filler block low in the foreground against its near face. NO translucent cubes in the box: a new Filler has its preview off

steps.name: f2-gui-off
steps.look: F2: the Filler screen. The new eye button is the small square directly ABOVE the invert button (top right of the panel), showing the white eye crossed out by a red diagonal slash ('preview off') as real art, not a purple-black missing-texture square; same button face and size as the excavate and invert buttons beside it

steps.name: f2-tooltip-off
steps.look: F2: tooltip 'Do Not Preview Fill' next to the cursor over the eye button, button not latched

steps.label: F2: hover the preview button again

steps.name: f2-tooltip-on
steps.look: F2: the eye button now shows the plain white open eye with its pupil ('preview on', no red slash) and its tooltip says 'Preview Fill'

steps.label: F2: the flag reached the tile (expect 1b)
F2: click the pattern slot (an in-place click picks the variant menu's centre entry, Fill)

steps.name: f2-gui-fill
steps.look: F2: the pattern slot now shows Fill (a solid dark square) and the eye button still shows the plain open eye; invert unchanged (solid square, not latched)

steps.name: f2-preview-on
steps.look: F2: the preview: a translucent grey-white cube in every cell of the 3x3x3 box (27, each a little smaller than its cell so neighbours read as separate, lighter on top, darker underneath), drawn over the box's outline. The Filler block is still low in front. Cubes missing, solid opaque cubes, or a cube sticking out of the box is the finding

steps.name: f2-preview-offscreen
steps.look: F2: looking south-south-west from the box's east side, so the Filler block is OUT of the picture (the box's north end, where it stands, is past the right edge) but most of the box is in it: the preview cubes still draw in that part of the box. No cubes here would mean the preview dies when the Filler block leaves the screen

steps.name: f2-gui-reopened
steps.look: F2: reopened: the eye button still shows the plain open eye ('Preview Fill' tooltip): the flag was saved and synced, not reset by closing the screen

steps.label: F2: press the preview button off
F2: hover the preview button again

steps.name: f2-tooltip-off-again
steps.look: F2: the eye button is back to the red-slashed eye and the tooltip says 'Do Not Preview Fill'

steps.label: F2: the flag is false again (expect 0b)

steps.name: f2-preview-off
steps.look: F2: the same view as f2-preview-on with the preview off: the box outline and the Filler block only, no cubes at all

steps.name: f2-preview-off-away
steps.look: F2: the same view as f2-preview-offscreen with the preview off: no cubes in the part of the box in view

steps.label: F3: a two-layer dirt patch and the Shovelman's home (shovel), its Work-in-Area zone over the patch
run: item replace block {X-6} {Y} {Z+6} container.0 with minecraft:iron_shovel
